title: Functional analysis of human circulating immune cells based on high-dimensional mass cytometry
protocol: Prepare cells and viability stain Timing: 8 h PBMCs isolation and red blood cells (RBCs) lysis.
Perform the PBMCs isolation from human blood samples by using Ficoll-Hypaque density gradient centrifugation methods.
Add 1 mL RBCs lysing buffer to each sample and incubate at 24°C for 1 min.
Add 10 mL culture medium to each sample to stop the lysis process.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g at 4°C for 5 min, carefully remove supernatant.
Repeat the wash once more with culture medium (2 washes in total).
Add 1 mL of culture medium to each tube to resuspend cells.
Count cells and determine the cell viability.
Perform Trypan Blue staining by mixing 10 μL cell suspension with 10 μL trypan blue.
Add the mixture into the counting slides and count using Cellometer Cell Counter.
Prepare cells for two different conditions.
Prepare and add 3 million cells to the cell culture plate.
Add the cell stimulation cocktails to each sample and incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 environment for 5 h.
Collect cells from culture plates and wash with PBS (name: stimulated group).
Name the cells without cocktails treatment as the unstimulated group.
Prepare 0.5 μM cisplatin working solution by adding 10 μL stock solution into 1 mL PBS.
Add 1 mL of cisplatin working solution to each sample and incubate at 24°C for 2 min to distinguish between dead and living cells.
Add 5 mL PBS to each sample to stop the staining reaction.
Mix well.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g at 4°C for 5 min.
Carefully remove supernatant.
Add 1 mL of CSB to each tube to resuspend cells.
Prepare 2× fixation solution at 24°C and ice-cold separately.
Add 1 mL of the 2× fixation solution to each tube.
Mix well.
Incubate tubes at 24°C for 10 min.
Add 4 mL of ice-cold CSB to each sample to slow down the fixation reaction.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 min.
Carefully remove supernatant.
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume.
Prepare cryopreservation solution by adding 1 part DMSO into 9 parts CSB.
Add 1 mL of cryopreservation solution to resuspend cells and place them on ice.
Count cells of each sample.
Calculate the volume of the cryopreservation solution required to obtain a final density of 3.5 million/mL of cells.
Add the calculated volume of cryopreservation solution to the cells.
Add 1 mL of cell suspension to each cryogenic vial for separate storage and store at -80°C.
Recover PBMCs from -80°C storage.
Preheat the water bath to 37°C.
Thaw cells from liquid nitrogen storage in a warm water bath at 37°C immediately.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Slowly add 10 mL of CSB drop by drop to minimize damage from concentration changes.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes, and carefully remove the supernatant.
Add 2 mL of CSB to each tube to resuspend cells.
Count cells and record viability.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes, and carefully remove the supernatant.
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in the residual volume (50 μL).
Resuscitate four samples from the unstimulated group and four from the stimulated group.
Prepare a mixture of surface antibodies CCR4 and CCR7 according to titration results.
Add CSB to the antibody mixture for a total volume of 50 μL.
Add 50 μL of the antibody mixture to each tube.
Gently pipette to mix well.
Incubate at 24°C for 15 min.
Gently vortex samples and incubate at 24°C for an additional 15 min.
Add 2 mL CSB to each tube to resuspend cells.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 min.
Carefully remove supernatant.
Repeat wash one more time with CSB (two washes in total).
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume of 50 μL.
Prepare the 1× Fix I Buffer by adding 1 part of 5× Fix I Buffer into 4 parts PBS.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL Fix I Buffer and incubate at 24°C for 10 minutes.
Add 1 mL CSB to each tube to slow down the fixation reaction.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 10 minutes, and carefully remove the supernatant.
Prepare the 1× Barcode Perm Buffer by adding 1 part of 10× Barcode Perm with 9 parts PBS.
Repeat the wash once more with Barcode Perm Buffer (2 washes in total).
Fully resuspend barcodes in 100 μL Barcode Perm Buffer.
Fully resuspend each sample to be barcoded in 800 μL Barcode Perm Buffer.
Transfer the barcodes to the corresponding samples, labeled with the respective barcoding group.
Mix the sample completely and incubate at 24°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes and carefully remove the supernatant.
Add 2 mL CSB to each tube to resuspend cells.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant.
Repeat wash once more with CSB (2 washes total).
Add 1 mL of CSB to each tube to resuspend cells.
Count cells in each sample and calculate the volume of CSB containing 0.75 million cells.
Combine four barcoded samples, with 0.75 million cells per sample, into one tube for the barcoded group.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant.
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume (50 μL).
Add 5 μL of FcR Blocking Solution to each tube and mix well.
Incubate the tubes at 24°C for 10 minutes.
Prepare a mixture of surface antibodies according to titration results.
Add CSB to the antibody mixture to reach a total volume of 50 μL.
Add 50 μL of the antibody mixture to each tube.
Gently pipette to mix well.
Incubate at 24°C for 15 minutes.
Gently vortex samples.
Incubate samples at 24°C for an additional 15 minutes.
Add 2 mL CSB to each tube.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Repeat wash one more time with CSB (2 washes in total).
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume.
Prepare the 1× Fix I Buffer by adding 10 mL of 5× Fix I Buffer into 40 mL PBS.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL Fix I Buffer.
Incubate at 24°C for 20 minutes.
Add 2 mL Perm-S Buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Repeat wash once more with Perm-S buffer (2 washes in total).
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume (50 μL).
Prepare the mixture of intracellular antibodies according to titration results.
Add Perm-S buffer to antibody mixture for a total volume of 50 μL.
Add 50 μL of antibody mixture to each tube.
Incubate samples at 24°C for 30 minutes.
Gently vortex samples.
Add 2 mL CSB to each tube.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Repeat wash once more with Perm-S buffer (2 washes in total).
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume (50 μL).
Prepare 2 mL cell intercalation solution for each barcoded group by adding 2 μL Cell-ID Intercalator-Ir (125 μM) into 2 mL Fix and Perm Buffer.
Add 1 mL of the prepared cell intercalation solution to each tube and gently vortex.
Leave tubes overnight at 4°C.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g for 5 min at 4°C after rewarming from 4°C storage.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL CSB in each tube.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume.
Add 2 mL of cell acquisition solution (CAS) to each tube.
Repeat centrifugation at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove the supernatant after the second wash.
Calculate the volume of CAS required to obtain a final density of 1 million/mL of cells.
Prepare a sufficient volume of 0.1× EQ beads solution by adding 1 part beads to 9 parts CAS.
Add the calculated volume of 0.1× EQ beads solution to resuspend cells.
Filter cells into cell strainer cap tubes.
Acquire each sample in Helios™ (WB Injector) with an acquisition rate of 300–350 events/s.
